theorem lg_target (G : Type u) [Group G] [Finite G] : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimitsOfShape (CategoryTheory.SingleObj G) FintypeCat := by
  constructor
  intro F
  let X := F.obj (default G)
  let ι : X ≅ X := iso.refl X
  use [X, ι]
  intros f g
  let Y := F.obj (default G)
  let Z := F.obj (default G)
  let φ : Y ≅ Z := iso.refl Y
  use [φ, φ]
  constructor
  intro h
  exact h
  intro h'
  exact h'
